LoginResponse.description: Untagged, so `ts-rs` emits the union of the variant payloads (`LoginResult | LoginChallenge`) with no tag to tell them apart.

VerifyOtpResponse.description: Untagged, and the three unit variants are indistinguishable on the wire: they all serialize to `null`, so the binding can only say what the payload is, not which case produced it. Two of the three are `ts`-skipped so the union is `LoginResult | null` instead of repeating `null` once per variant.
